description.text: The Beginning Set of the XY series, its first product, released on 8 November 2013 together with Beginning Set for Girl. It held three ready-built 30-card half decks led by Chesnaught, Delphox and Greninja, the final evolutions of the Kalos starters, with a playmat, a coin, damage counters and markers, a rule book, a player's guide and a how-to-play DVD presented by Meowth. The for Girl version differs in some Pokémon cards and in its items' designs. DX editions of both, with the same cards plus a deck case, sleeves, stickers and a trunk case, followed on 15 November 2013.
